title: Preserve layer assignment when extracting a Boot-generated index
summary: Compares physical layer contents from a genuinely generated index and a separate hand-authored overlapping index under each original extractor.

change.description: The tools JAR mode indexes exact file names and directory prefixes separately for faster layer lookup during extraction. The PR’s equivalence argument depends on the indexes generated by Boot’s packager.

notes: Both inputs use the same S49 packager to produce the ordinary compacted index. The root launcher class files are then taken from the respective S46 build, and the nested tools JAR is byte-identical to its S46 original. The mixed-index experiment edits only that index.
